title: Restriction of the direct image to bounded constructibles
statement:
Let $\Lambda=P_n$ be as in
[def-weil-pbc-constructible-direct-image-finiteness], let $u:S\to T$ be a
morphism of schemes, and suppose $\mathrm{FIN}(u,\Lambda;c)$. Then the
ambient functor $Ru_*$ restricts to an exact triangulated functor
$$
 Ru_*:\Dbc(S_{\Proet},\Lambda)\longrightarrow\Dbc(T_{\Proet},\Lambda),
$$
and if $K\in\Dbc(S_{\Proet},\Lambda)$ has cohomology in $[a,b]$, then
$Ru_*K$ has cohomology in $[a,b+c]$.

note:
*Source note:* no Stacks Project entry states this conditional restriction.
Stacks' constructibility entries are Definition 61.29.1 ([Tag
09C1](https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/09C1)) and Proposition 61.29.7
([Tag 09C7](https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/09C7)), stated on a
Noetherian scheme for a Noetherian coefficient ring, together with Lemma
61.29.2 ([Tag 09C2](https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/09C2)), which
realizes one constructible $K$ as $\Rlim K_n$ with each $K_n$ of bounded tor
amplitude, constructible cohomology and etale origin; the finiteness and
amplitude inputs are Lemma 59.92.2 ([Tag
095U](https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/095U): for $f$ proper with all
fibres of dimension $\le n$ and every abelian torsion sheaf $\mathcal F$ on
$X_{\Et}$ one has $R^qf_*\mathcal F=0$ for $q>2n$) and Theorem 63.14.5 ([Tag
0GL0](https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0GL0): for $f$ separated of
finite presentation and $K\in D^+_{tors,c}(X_{\Et},\Lambda)$, $Rf_!K$ has
constructible cohomology sheaves). Difference: both are etale-site
statements about a single coefficient ring, with no amplitude shift, no
uniformity over a coefficient tower and no pro-etale site; the blueprint
adds the transport of these conditions to the small pro-etale sites as the
predicate $\mathrm{FIN}(u,\Lambda;c)$ and the amplitude shift by $c$.

proof.text: Specialize the already stated isBoundedConstructibleFiniteCoefficient_isTriangulated to the discrete topology. This closes finiteCoefficientBoundedConstructible_isTriangulated. The essential-image property is closed under isomorphisms by ObjectProperty.map.

Work throughout in the recorded FiniteCoefficientModules category. Constructible etale module sheaves are invariant under isomorphism and include zero, by isConstructibleEtaleModuleSheaf_iff_isConstructibleSheaf and the existing IsConstructibleSheaf API. Thus constructible etale origin is invariant under isomorphism and includes zero. If F has constructible etale origin E, the single complex E[0] is a bounded constructible witness for F[0]: its degree-zero homology is E, its other homology is zero, and mapDerivedCategorySingleFunctor identifies its comparison image with F[0]. The constructible-stratum field of the existing stratification supplies the explicit stratum condition.

An essential-image witness L for K gives boundedness of K because exact comparison preserves the canonical t-structure bounds. The exact comparison homology isomorphism identifies H^j(K) with the comparison image of H^j(L), so every cohomology sheaf has constructible etale origin. Conversely, apply the proved source-library DerivedCategory.prop_of_bounded to the triangulated essential-image property, using step 2 for single constructible sheaves. This is the finite canonical-truncation induction of that source theorem and proves precisely the recorded essential-image characterization, without changing coefficient encodings.

Transport enough injectives from fixed-coefficient module-valued sheaves along the inverse of the recorded finiteCoefficientRealization equivalence. The proved source theorem isGE_rightDerivedFunctor_obj_singleFunctor then gives negative vanishing of ordinary derived direct image on F[0]. FIN gives constructible etale origin in nonnegative degrees and vanishing above c for a constructible F. Hence its derived image is bounded in [0,c] and bounded constructible by step 3. Apply DerivedCategory.prop_of_bounded again, now to the inverse image of the target triangulated object property under ordinary derived direct image. Step 3 supplies the source boundedness and constructible cohomology, proving preservation on every object.

Prove constructibleAmplitude by induction on n for K with cohomology in [a,a+n-1], assuming only constructibility of its cohomology in that interval. For n=0, K and its image are zero. For n+1, set b=a+n and use the canonical distinguished triangle truncLT b K -> K -> truncGE b K. The left term has interval [a,b-1] and the same cohomology below b, so the induction hypothesis applies. The right term is concentrated in degree b, hence is a single sheaf F in that degree. Its H^b is H^b(K), giving constructibility of F. Shift compatibility transfers the degree-zero image interval [0,c] to [b,b+c]. Apply the ambient triangulated functor to the triangle; the t-structure extension lemmas, consequences of the long exact cohomology sequence, put its middle image in [a,b+c]. For an arbitrary nonempty [a,b], choose n=(b-a+1).toNat. For an empty interval, K and its image are zero. This proves the sharp stated estimate without assuming FIN for nonconstructible sheaves.

Lift the composite of the full source inclusion and the ambient derived functor using the preservation proof in step 4. ObjectProperty.isTriangulated_lift supplies exact triangulatedness with the inherited shift comparison and unchanged ambient morphism maps. Pair it with the interval estimate of step 5.

blueprint_update.statement:
Let $\Lambda=P_n$ be as in
[def-weil-pbc-constructible-direct-image-finiteness], let $u:S\to T$ be a
morphism of schemes, and suppose $\mathrm{FIN}(u,\Lambda;c)$. Then the
ambient functor $Ru_*$ restricts to an exact triangulated functor
$$
 Ru_*:\Dbc(S_{\Proet},\Lambda)\longrightarrow\Dbc(T_{\Proet},\Lambda),
$$
and if $K\in\Dbc(S_{\Proet},\Lambda)$ has cohomology in $[a,b]$, then
$Ru_*K$ has cohomology in $[a,b+c]$.

proof.text:
An object $K\in\Dbc(S_{\Proet},\Lambda)$ has constructible cohomology
sheaves $F_q=\mathcal H^q(K)$, zero outside the finite interval $[a,b]$. The
truncation-couple spectral sequence applied to the left exact $u_*$ gives
$$
 E_2^{p,q}=R^pu_*F_q\Longrightarrow\mathcal H^{p+q}(Ru_*K),
$$
with $E_2^{p,q}$ constructible for all $p,q$ by clause (i) of
[def-weil-pbc-constructible-direct-image-finiteness] and zero for $p>c$ by
clause (ii). For fixed $n=p+q$, the finite filtration of a convergent
spectral sequence exhibits $\mathcal H^n(Ru_*K)$ as a subquotient of a
finite extension of the constructible $E_\infty$-terms, hence constructible
by [thm-constructible-serre]; only $a\leq q\leq n$ and $p\leq c$
contribute, so $\mathcal H^n(Ru_*K)=0$ for $n\notin[a,b+c]$. Exactness is
the exactness of the ambient $Ru_*$ on the full triangulated subcategory
$\Dbc(S_{\Proet},\Lambda)$.
